audit_name: Decision Threshold Calibration & Test Quarantine Leakage Audit

audited_threshold_workflows.tuning_methodology: 5-fold stratified candidate-cluster cross-validation. For each fold, candidate resumes in the validation fold were masked, optimal threshold tau was selected strictly on the inner training folds, and evaluated on the held-out candidate cluster.
audited_threshold_workflows.scientific_verdict: Methodologically sound out-of-fold calibration. Achieved 47.64% accuracy (+1.69 pp gain over argmax) and recovered Good Fit recall from 5.38% to 11.83% without data leakage.

audited_threshold_workflows.audit_finding: The 50.26% held-out test score was an attribution error. It originated from Phase 12F EXP-12F-PSEUDO (Hybrid Stacking augmented with confidence-gated pseudo-labels), where the standard argmax decision rule was evaluated on held-out test features. No threshold tuning was conducted against official held-out test labels.
audited_threshold_workflows.scientific_verdict: Test set labels were not accessed or tuned upon. However, because 50.26% represents EXP-12F-PSEUDO rather than a validated frozen threshold rule, it is classified as EXPLORATORY PSEUDO-LABELING RESEARCH and excluded from production promotion decisions.

governance_mandate: Strict quarantine is maintained. Threshold tuning directly on official held-out test labels is permanently forbidden.
